title: BlockRoulette
description: summons TNT when a Block is broken with a changable Chance
body:
**Break a block, and TNT may spawn!**

This mod adds a configurable chance for TNT to appear whenever a block is mined.
The probability is adjustable via a gamerule, with the default value 167 (≈16.7%).
Higher values make TNT spawn more often, lower values make it rarer.

Perfect for chaos gameplay, survival challenges, and fun content.
